annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅转发民政部等部门《关于进一步加强养老机构安全管理的意见》的通知
annotation.title_en: General Office of the State Council Circular Forwarding the Opinions on Further Strengthening Safety Management of Elderly Care Institutions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council); 民政部等
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office circular forwarding ministerial opinions on strengthening safety management of elderly care institutions: joint inspections, risk grading, fire and facility upgrades, operator responsibility, supervision, mandatory national standards and funding. Mentions smart smoke detectors and cameras only incidentally; no robotics governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish joint inspection mechanism, at least one joint inspection per year per institution
Dynamic safety risk grading with 'one institution, one plan' remediation
Institution heads are first responsible persons; safety officer posts required
Issue mandatory national standards on major hazard determination and basic institutional norms
Targets: hazards dynamically cleared by end-2026, long-term mechanism by 2028
